title: Reverse Second Half of Array

content.problemStatement: Complete the code snippet below to reverse the second half of the array (in place replacement).

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Reverse the second half of the array.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    n = int(toks[0])
    arr = toks[1:n+1]
    half = n // 2
    arr[half:] = reversed(arr[half:])
    print(" ".join(arr))
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

solution.editorial: Calculate half = N / 2. Keep first half intact and reverse elements from index half to N-1.

hints: Reverse elements from index half to N - 1.
